title: Quick Maths
description: How many math problems can you solve in 60 seconds? Problems start easy and level up to bigger numbers, times tables, and division as your score climbs. Build a streak for bonus time.
howto: Click or tap the right answer, or press 1 to 4 on your keyboard. Wrong answers cost 3 seconds. Every 5 correct in a row adds 2 seconds.

title: Answer Rush
description: A math problem appears at the top, and number bubbles pop up all over the board. Hit the bubble with the right answer as fast as you can. Quick answers score more points, and problems get harder as you go.
howto: Click or tap the bubble with the correct answer. Wrong answers cost 3 seconds. You have 45 seconds.

title: Number Snake
description: Snake with a math twist. The rule at the top tells you which numbers to eat, like multiples of 3. Eat the right numbers to grow, avoid the wrong ones, and watch for the rule to change every few bites.
howto: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, or swipe on a phone. Eating a wrong number costs 3 segments. Hitting a wall or yourself ends the game.

title: Equation Match
description: A memory game where every pair is a math problem and its answer. Flip cards two at a time and match 7 × 8 with 56, 45 ÷ 9 with 5, and so on. Clear all eight pairs in as few moves as you can.
howto: Click or tap a card to flip it, then flip a second one. If one card is a problem and the other is its answer, they stay face-up. Every game deals new problems.

description: The classic number-merging puzzle. Slide every tile on the board at once, and when two tiles with the same number touch, they combine into one. Keep merging to build bigger numbers and try to reach the 2048 tile before the board fills up.
howto: Use the arrow keys or WASD to slide the tiles. On a phone, swipe in any direction. Press the New Game button to start over.

title: Times Table Tower
description: Build the tallest tower you can, one multiplication fact at a time. Every right answer drops a new block onto the stack, but answer wrong or too slowly and the top block tumbles off. The timer gets shorter and the facts get bigger as your tower grows.
howto: Tap or click the right answer, or press 1 to 4. You have 3 lives, and each wrong or late answer costs one.

title: Fraction Pizza
description: Run a pizza shop where every customer orders a fraction. Put pepperoni on exactly the right share of the pizza and serve it before time runs out. Later orders come on pizzas cut into extra slices, so ½ might mean 4 out of 8.
howto: Tap slices to add or remove pepperoni, then press Serve or Enter. Correct pizzas add 2 seconds; wrong ones cost 5.

title: Make the Number
description: You get four numbers and a target. Combine the numbers with +, −, × and ÷ until you land exactly on the target. Every puzzle has at least one solution, and there's often more than one way to get there.
howto: Tap a number, then an operation, then another number to combine them. Keep going until one number is left. Use Undo or Restart if you get stuck, or Skip to try a new puzzle.
